release_notes_en: Smart notification deep-linking (Option B: opens Follow-Up FU 1 queue and the target patient conversation directly), dedicated Follow-Up filter tab (FU 1, FU 2, FU 3) in Inbox, and in-thread AI Follow-Up action card (Send Now, Edit, Skip).
